sentences.text: Rahul And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023

Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh
Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 7664 of 2020
Applicant :- Rahul And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Onkar Singh,Sachin Malik
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for accused-applicants and Sri Sanjay Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for State and
perused the record.

2.  The present application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the accused-applicants seeking bail in anticipation of their arrest in Case Crime No. 25 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323,
354, 354B, 376, 511, 377, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Muzaffarnagar.

3. Learned counsel for applicants contends that applicant-2 is brother-in-law and applicant-3 Smt.
Kuldeep is mother-in-law of complainant and they have been granted interim protection by this Court vide order dated 05.11.2020.
He further submits that the charge sheet has already been filed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 4. Though, the learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
However he could not dispute the facts as noted above.

5. Considering the aforesaid fact that the charge sheet has already been filed as well as the relationship of the applicant Nos. 2 and 3 of the complainant coupled with the fact that the applicant Nos. 2 and 3 have been granted interim protection by this Court vide order dated 05.11.2020, no purpose would be served in taking the accused applicant Nos. 2 and 3 in custody.
6. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application is allowed only in respect of accused-applicant Nos. 2 and 3.

The accused-applicant Nos. 2 and 3 are directed to appear before the trial Court concerned within ten days from today and if they do so, they shall be released on their furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, on the following conditions, which are imposed in the interest of justice, and other conditions, which may be desirable by the learned trial Court:-

(i) That the applicant Nos. 2 and 3 shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) That the applicant Nos. 2 and 3 shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer;

(iii) That the applicant Nos. 2 and 3 shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court; and (iv) Such other conditions as may be imposed under sub-section (3) of Section 437, as if the bail were granted under that section.
7. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial or deciding the regular bail application.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Arun K. Singh  Rahul And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180790749/
